about: Messages someone dictates to a coding agent in Milagre. `spoken` is what the voice says (read by macOS text to speech, or by you for a recorded clip), `expected` what should land in the composer, `terms` the technical words that must come out spelled exactly. Cases with no terms are controls: ordinary speech the vocabulary must not rewrite.

cases.spoken: Ask Codex to review the pull request before we merge it.
cases.expected: Ask Codex to review the pull request before we merge it.

cases.spoken: Switch this chat to Claude and use Opus for the plan.
cases.expected: Switch this chat to Claude and use Opus for the plan.

cases.spoken: Open voice dictation dot ts and check the insert dictation function.
cases.expected: Open voice-dictation.ts and check the insertDictation function.

cases.spoken: The bug is in the use dictation hook, the vocabulary arrives after the first partial.
cases.expected: The bug is in the useDictation hook, the vocabulary arrives after the first partial.

cases.spoken: Kiro and Antigravity both talk to Milagre over A C P.
cases.expected: Kiro and Antigravity both talk to Milagre over ACP.

cases.spoken: Deploy the relay worker to Cloudflare with wrangler.
cases.expected: Deploy the relay worker to Cloudflare with wrangler.

cases.spoken: Ship an O T A update with E A S after the TestFlight build passes.
cases.expected: Ship an OTA update with EAS after the TestFlight build passes.

cases.spoken: Move the heartbeat logic into routines dot mjs.
cases.expected: Move the heartbeat logic into routines.mjs.

cases.spoken: Milagre should keep the worktree when the daemon restarts.
cases.expected: Milagre should keep the worktree when the daemon restarts.

cases.spoken: Add a Supabase migration and update the Vercel environment.
cases.expected: Add a Supabase migration and update the Vercel environment.

cases.spoken: Prompt composer re-renders on every keystroke, can you profile it?
cases.expected: PromptComposer re-renders on every keystroke, can you profile it?

cases.spoken: Check the GitHub Actions logs, the Electron smoke job is flaky.
cases.expected: Check the GitHub Actions logs, the Electron smoke job is flaky.

cases.spoken: Whisper prompt cuts the vocabulary at six hundred characters.
cases.expected: whisperPrompt cuts the vocabulary at six hundred characters.

cases.spoken: Rename mobile bridge dot cjs and update the command contracts.
cases.expected: Rename mobile-bridge.cjs and update the command contracts.

cases.spoken: Gemini and OpenAI models should show up in the model picker.
cases.expected: Gemini and OpenAI models should show up in the model picker.

cases.spoken: Expo Router crashes when the iPad sidebar opens.
cases.expected: Expo Router crashes when the iPad sidebar opens.

cases.spoken: The Claude Code C L I hides the task tools in headless mode.
cases.expected: The Claude Code CLI hides the task tools in headless mode.

cases.spoken: Run N P M run typecheck in the desktop app.
cases.expected: Run npm run typecheck in the desktop app.

cases.spoken: The create streaming dictation function seals a segment on every pause.
cases.expected: The createStreamingDictation function seals a segment on every pause.

cases.spoken: Codex keeps timing out on thread start, check the M C P servers.
cases.expected: Codex keeps timing out on thread start, check the MCP servers.

cases.spoken: Tell Kiro to fix the failing test in dictation dot test dot mjs.
cases.expected: Tell Kiro to fix the failing test in dictation.test.mjs.

cases.spoken: Milagre needs the Linear issue card on the phone too.
cases.expected: Milagre needs the Linear issue card on the phone too.

cases.spoken: Convert this component to TypeScript and keep the React Native styles.
cases.expected: Convert this component to TypeScript and keep the React Native styles.

cases.spoken: We use dictation a lot when we are away from the desk.
cases.expected: We use dictation a lot when we are away from the desk.

cases.spoken: The prompt editor feels slow, and the context bar is too tall.
cases.expected: The prompt editor feels slow, and the context bar is too tall.

cases.spoken: I think the code looks fine, let's merge it tomorrow morning.
cases.expected: I think the code looks fine, let's merge it tomorrow morning.

cases.spoken: Can you explain how the chat history is stored in the cloud?
cases.expected: Can you explain how the chat history is stored in the cloud?

cases.spoken: Abre o prompt composer e corrige o bug do Codex.
cases.expected: Abre o PromptComposer e corrige o bug do Codex.

cases.spoken: Pede pro Claude revisar o pull request do Milagre.
cases.expected: Pede pro Claude revisar o pull request do Milagre.

cases.spoken: O arquivo voice dictation ponto ts está quebrado no Android.
cases.expected: O arquivo voice-dictation.ts está quebrado no Android.

cases.spoken: Faz o deploy no Cloudflare e depois manda a atualização O T A.
cases.expected: Faz o deploy no Cloudflare e depois manda a atualização OTA.
